avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce oxymorphone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before discontinuing if already taking

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; additive CNS depression and respiratory depression
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue kava kava; do not use with oxymorphone

avoid_supplements.name: Alcohol-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Severe additive CNS and respiratory depression; increased overdose risk
avoid_supplements.action: Strictly avoid all alcohol and alcohol-containing products

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; report unusual drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase oxymorphone exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; maintain consistent intake if using

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases oxymorphone levels and overdose risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; no safe consumption level established

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May alter oxymorphone absorption kinetics; extended-release formulations affected
caution_foods.action: Take on consistent meal schedule; avoid variable fat intake around dosing

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase CNS stimulation and mask sedation; counteracts opioid effects
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor pain control and alertness

monitoring_notes: Monitor for respiratory depression, excessive sedation, and constipation. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of alcohol and grapefruit products, and advise maintaining consistent meal timing with extended-release formulations to ensure stable drug absorption.
